name: what about poe
source:
cherry blossom high, home of three(ish) eligible, romanceable boys!

Beaux, the cheer captain and town sweetheart!

Poe, resident snarky bookworm and poet!

Rue, school badboy and infamous delinquent!

...can YOU warm the hearts of these three(ish) boys?

[from [url=https://moonworks-studio.itch.io/what-about-poe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
樱花高中，三个合格的浪漫男孩的家！

Beaux，啦啦队长和镇上的甜心！

坡，常住的尖酸刻薄的书虫和诗人！

鲁，学校坏孩子和臭名昭著的不良少年！

…你能温暖这三个男孩的心吗？

[来自[url=https://moonworks-studio.itch.io/what-about-poe]itch.io[/url]]
